column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE PREVENTION OF CRIMES
ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 22)
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This Act may be cited as the Prevention of Crimes
(Amendment) Act, No.   of 2017.

2.
Section  2  of  the  Prevention  of  Crimes  Ordinance
(Chapter  22)  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  “principal
enactment”)  is  hereby  amended  in  sub-paragraph  (i)  of
paragraph (b) of subsection (3) thereof, by the substitution
for the words and figures, “by section 302 of the Criminal
Procedure Code”, of the words and figures, “by section 277
of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979”.

3.
Section  3  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended  in  subsection  (1)  thereof,  by  the  substitution  for
the words and figures “under section 325(1) of the Criminal
Procedure  Code,  the  Magistrate  shall,  notwithstanding
anything in section 190 of the Criminal Procedure Code”,
of the words and figures, “under section 306 of the Code of
Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979, the Magistrate shall,
notwithstanding anything in section 185 of that Act,”.

4.
